decision: Ready to continue the team boilerplate on the supported stack after adopting a retrievable reviewed revision and the documented migrations. Private candidate acceptance is not publication or production certification.

environment.database_policy: Existing services and retained isolated namespaces; no resets or duplicate servers.

failures_and_corrections: Initial full verification found a stale version-4 JavaScript fixture assertion; it now receives manifest.Version from Go.

Race verification exposed cache load overcounting and two test timing assumptions. Counters now record actual loader invocation; cache refresh and scheduler capacity tests use deterministic synchronization without weakening assertions.

Candidate 02 starter upgrade required the client-aware password login declaration, updated migration expectations, explicit immediate scheduler capacity policy in its test, and precise MaximumPage validation expectations.

Candidate 02 passed single starter verification but failed repeated queue CLI race checks with exit 66. Dedicated stack capture identified database.Rows.stop registration versus automatic Close. Existing row mutex now protects registration. Candidate 02 is superseded.

Private harness setup corrected a missing candidate ZIP checksum, a copy filter that omitted the existing TypeScript bin directory, and container HOME leaking into the host Docker client environment. No tools/dependencies were upgraded or installed.
limits: Private candidate only; no public revision was published and the real starter was not repinned.
Linux evidence is the independent starter on arm64 in the existing image, not the entire framework suite on every Linux architecture.
Offline systemd unit validation and direct process signals were checked; live systemd supervision was not exercised.
Live S3/R2/provider-account certification and real email sends were not repeated; no new production deployment claim.
Token impersonation, cache failover, sendfile, lossy WebP, comment-derived schema descriptions and the four deferred scaffolds remain out of scope.

negative_control.reason: The new cancellation-during-driver-return regression reproduced the data race in an isolated copy of candidate 02. The fixed regression passed 20 x 200 cancellations, automatic owner release, one driver close and connection reuse.

scope: Bounded stabilization of the improvement-program changes before team boilerplate adoption; auth, transactions, outbox/jobs, generated contracts and independent dependency consumption. Deferred parity was not added.

security.review: No affected runtime function findings; module-only GO-2026-5932 remains, with no OpenPGP imports in the packaged consumer graphs. Existing gopls has documented module-only advisories with no affected binary symbols. TypeScript lockfile audit has zero findings. All external module versions and license/notice hashes match the prior review.

source_and_tools.policy: Fail tool errors, malformed/incomplete results, affected function findings or any npm vulnerability. Preserve module/package-only findings for review.

starter.tests: Full independent required-integration gate, explicit DTO privacy/client checks, cross-process jobs, service-free CLI, Linux offline unit validation and non-root native HTTP SIGTERM/SIGINT shutdown.

earlier_full_race.limitation: Passed before the independent starter stress exposed the row cleanup-hook race. Final source reran affected runtime and consumer race suites, complete make verify and native/Linux starter stress.

version_control: No commit, push, merge, tag or publication.
